name: Logo Designer
description: Designs one original SVG logo symbol from a brand brief. Returns SVG source as an inert code block, not a rendered or verified artifact. No browsing, tools, mockups, or financial actions. Model usage is provider-asserted.

actions.description: Create one simple SVG logo symbol from the brand name, audience, visual direction and preferred colors. No lettering, alternatives or brand kit; output is inert SVG source.

variants.description: One bounded model call; no automatic fallback.

dataPolicy.retention: Operation inputs and results remain in the provider's local SQLite database until the operator deletes the database offline. Upstream model retention follows the operator's OpenAI agreement.
dataPolicy.terms: Development sample only. Real model calls cost the provider money. SVG source is not a verified image artifact, trademark clearance, or guarantee of originality. No marketplace billing, uptime guarantee, cancellation, or artifact delivery. Replace the placeholder endpoint and review policies before publishing.
